name: Denver Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Training and Hiring
what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a Denver pool. If you are not certified, the city trains you for free first. You may also teach swim lessons or help at the front desk.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 15 when you apply and by the last day of the training class.
pay_detail: $19.29 per hour for new lifeguards. Red Cross certification is free if you will work for the city.
deadline_text: Hiring year-round. The page gives no deadline.
how_to_apply: Apply on the city job site. Next is a short phone interview with the water team. Then take the free lifeguard class (you pass a swim pre-test first). Last is city hiring and onboarding.
notes: The pay and steps were read through a page reader, so confirm the pay on the city job posting. The page says the city needs early morning and daytime guards who can work year-round.
